title: Under JUnit 5, each variant the engine selects can be a test of its own: a failing variant fails only its own test, and the withheld contract fails the class.
why: behavioural spec 'execute': the closure runs once per selected variant, and a failed variant fails that variant only. 'finalise': when the result carries no contract, it fails, naming every interaction and variant whose status is not 'verified'. The JVM style guide, 'Test-framework integration': janus.variants returned from a @TestFactory makes each selected variant its own dynamic test, named 'label [id]', or 'base' for the base variant.
note: JUnit 5 alone has this spelling, its dynamic tests. Under every framework, 'execute' runs every variant within one test (framework/withheld-contract-fails-the-suite).
